notes.title: Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut plays great on the Steam Deck or with a controller!
notes.content:
Hello, detectives! Since the Steam deck is launching today, we wanted to emphasize to you all that Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut features full controller support, including Steam Deck compatibility!

We’ve had first-hand experience with this new handheld, and you’re in for a treat — the Director’s Cut plays AMAZINGLY on it!

As you may know, the Director’s Cut’s introduces, alongside the new 16:9 aspect ratio, an extended storyline with a more fleshed-out ending, additional puzzles, a remixed soundtrack, and new game environments.

For a more relaxed playthrough, plug in, sit back, seamlessly take control of Kathy and crack the case, either on your Steam Deck or with any other controller!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11113042/5d67405d4ea858dffdca16612e1b1fd3515e62e7.jpg

Owners of the classic version can purchase the Director’s cut at a -50% discount below:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22677/Kathy_Rain_Loyal_Detective_Bundle/
Note: This discount can be used alongside other offers or discounts.

notes.title: Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut is Live!
notes.content:
It’s been 5 years since we released Kathy Rain, and launch day for the Director’s Cut is finally upon us! We couldn’t be more excited to share our third game with you all — the definite version of Kathy Rain. We believe that KR: DC elevates Kathy’s journey to a whole new level, opening many doors for the future of Kathy Rain!

Grab Kathy Rain: Director's Cut on Steam!

While you wait for the download to start, enjoy our launch trailer below, and as always — thank you for being here. We wouldn’t be able to do this if it wasn’t for all of you, and we sincerely hope that Kathy will bring you some joy in this spooky season!

notes.title: Director’s Cut Highlights
notes.content:
Welcome to our TED talk, highlighting the changes and upgrades to Kathy Rain in its Director’s Cut. A lot of people have been asking us what the differences are between the original and the upcoming version, so we wanted to highlight some of the major reasons that it's worth returning to Conwell Springs!

Added Locations:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/cc1994ff204e98557a5214fa2b22af41c8eb91ed.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/787fc3fad15bf231476482caa2ae770222080f12.jpg

There is more to love in Conwell Springs as new and returning players will have the chance to explore brand new areas of Kathy’s hometown. Each new location features stunning backgrounds as seen in the examples above!


Added Puzzles:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/f126b38ca70735a79180b91d10fb1e7c5d64118d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/4590650930200ffe6cad65fb9fb8f503a583f28f.jpg

What’s a good point-and-click mystery without its challenging puzzles? Kathy Rain had some doozies and the Director’s Cut is bringing more of those challenges that will tease your brain.

Extended Ending:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/363e30ef173e32c65df01a87a9bbe8689f1e2eca.jpg

OK, the above image is a bit of a tease and we don’t want to spoil anything, but players returning to Kathy Rain can expect some new twists and turns to the ending that help flesh out Kathy’s character and the story as a whole.

Aspect Ratio:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/a9969ae9baf3c7b24c57d40ac635b66d90096d8f.jpg

Kathy Rain is expanding from 4:3 to 16:9. This means that there will be more details to explore as the Director’s Cut will fill up your screen!

Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut is launching in October of this year — make sure it’s on your wishlist on the Director's Cut Steam Page as we will be taking a deep dive into the game right here on Steam.

- Clifftop Games

notes.title: Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut Announcement
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce the Director’s Cut of the award-winning adventure Kathy Rain — the new and definite way to experience the rise of an iconic detective.

In the almost five years since Kathy Rain launched, we’ve been blown away by the reception of the game and the passion of the community. Thanks to everyone that has played the game so far, given feedback and shared their experience!

All of this has led us to our mission to create a refined and expanded version of Kathy Rain, created from the ground up in a modern, up-to-date game engine.

We have taken everything we’ve learned during these years to give you the most complete realization of Kathy’s journey yet. Once again, a detective is born...

[previewyoutube=SV5-E0mm7zc;full][/previewyoutube]

For both new and returning visitors to Conwell Springs, there’s lots to look forward to...


 Extended storyline with a prolonged ending, hundreds of lines of additional dialogue, and multiple new areas to explore.
 Several new major puzzle chains along with many small additions and tweaks of existing puzzles.
 Enlarged game environments to fill up the entire screen without any black bars on the sides.
 Countless visual improvements, such as more character animations, better lighting/shadows and extra weather effects.
 Streamlined mouse controls with an intuitive single click interface.
 Controller support done right. Lean back in your chair and take smooth direct control of Kathy, with no messy cursor getting in the way.
 Expanded and remixed soundtrack by the original composer, Daniel Kobylarz.
 Five brand new motorcycle designs to unlock and customize the Katmobile with.


We’ve still got more to show of Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut, so stay tuned. We’d appreciate you wishlisting the game to show both us and Steam that you’re looking forward to playing!

Wishlist Now

notes.title: Kathy Rain v.1.0.3 patch up!
notes.content:
Changelog:

 Fixed a showstopper related to the chase sequence in the final chapter of the game.
 Fixed a crash related to a few pixels of a deleted hotspot near the typewriter in the attic.
 Fixed an error in the French translation, resulting in an invalid hint concerning the poem puzzle.
 Fixed a bug causing the sequence connected to the "Undateable" achievement to not trigger properly.
 Fixed a bug causing the player to be able to unlock "Passive Smoking" without Goober present.
 Fixed a showstopper related to opening the menu in the middle of an action sequence.
 Updated the main menu background to reflect the newest logo design.

notes.title: Kathy Rain v.1.0.2 patch up!
notes.content:
Changelog:

Tapes should now always translate correctly after loading savegames, preventing a potential showstopper when playing in German or French.
Fixed a rare glitch state for the dictaphone which could cause the game to get stuck.
Took care of a showstopper when leaving the room with the safe numpad UI still open.
Shortened the speech clips of a character in the final chapter of the game, they were unnecessarily long.
Kathy can no longer step on the kid in the cemetery.
The label next to the checkbox in the options should no longer change to "New label" when loading some savegames.
Kathy will no longer freeze out of pure confusion if Goober moves away as she is about to show him an inventory item in the clinic.
Added a new special cutscene with Kathy and Grandma where they adress the emotional discovery in the storage facility.
Kathy now denies showing the Sheriff a particular item a second time, instead of the game not reacting at all.
Took care of a visual glitch when showing Grandma one of the tapes from outside of dialogue.
Fixed a number of cases of mismatching text and VO.
Fixed a crash if the player would try to remove a tape from the dictaphone during playback.
